title: rate-limit-memory-leak
goal: Rate-limit memory leak in serve — add TTL cleanup for HITS map. In `src/cli/serve.ts`, the `HITS: Map<string, number[]>` grows unboundedly. Add `setInterval` every 60s that removes entries where ALL timestamps are older than WINDOW_MS (60s). Use `NODE_ENV=test` guard to skip interval in tests.
constraints: zero-dependency; edit src/cli/serve.ts; test-safe (skip interval in vitest env)
